sub-flow.name: pf-apply-transforms
sub-flow.doc:description: Fetch each changed file and apply matrix rewrites; stage new contents.

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG apply-transforms enter
logger.message: #['LOG DEBUG | flow=pf-apply-transforms | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | files=' ++ sizeOf((vars.changePlan.fileEdits default []) map $.file distinctBy $)]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- ((vars.changePlan.fileEdits default []) groupBy ((e) -> e.file)) pluck ((edits, path, idx) -> { path: (path as String), edits: edits })

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output text/plain import rewritePomProperties from dwl::rewritePomProperties import rewriteMunitRuntime from dwl::rewriteMunitRuntime import rewriteMuleArtifact from dwl::rewriteMuleArtifact import rewriteCiWorkflow from dwl::rewriteCiWorkflow import fromBase64 from dw::core::Binaries var rawText = (fromBase64((payload.content default "") replace /[\r\n\t ]/ with "")) as String {encoding: "UTF-8"} var edits = vars.currentFileEdits default [] var propEdits = edits filter ((e) -> e.kind == "pomProperty") var step1 = if (!isEmpty(propEdits)) rewritePomProperties(rawText, propEdits) else rawText var munitEdit = edits firstWith ((e) -> e.kind == "munitRuntimeVersion") var step2 = if (munitEdit != null) rewriteMunitRuntime(step1, munitEdit.to as String) else step1 var maEdit = edits firstWith ((e) -> e.kind == "muleArtifactJson") var step3 = if (maEdit != null) rewriteMuleArtifact(step2, maEdit.to.minMuleVersion as String, maEdit.to.javaSpecificationVersions) else step2 var ciEdit = edits firstWith ((e) -> e.kind == "ciWorkflow") var step4 = if (ciEdit != null) rewriteCiWorkflow(step3, ciEdit.to as String) else step3 --- step4

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO staged files
logger.message: #['LOG INFO | flow=pf-apply-transforms | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | staged=' ++ sizeOf(vars.stagedFiles default [])]
